timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the audit run

concept_slug.description: Canonical identifier for the active concept

attempt_number.description: Sequential repair iteration counter (bounded by max_repair_attempts)

rewind_target.description: Optional explicit pipeline rewind stage when failures originate in mapping.json (STAGE_2_MAPPING) or manifest.json (STAGE_1_SPECIFICATION)

failures.description: Structured counter-examples and failed verification obligations

obligation_id.description: Identifier of the failed verification obligation (e.g. 'OBL-1')

failure_classification.description: Actionable root-cause categorization: IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT routes to @Engineer (Stage 3); MAPPING_DEFECT / SPECIFICATION_AMBIGUITY rewinds to @Formalist (Stage 2); MANIFEST_DEFECT rewinds to @Researcher (Stage 1)

defect_type.description: Accepted alias normalized to failure_classification on save

defect_category.description: Accepted alias normalized to failure_classification on save

minimal_counterexample.description: Minimal input values triggering the discrepancy or assertion failure

expected_oracle.description: Ground-truth value, expression, or invariant requirement from oracle

actual_observed.description: Observed output or exception from the implementation under test

violated_invariant.description: Mathematical, physical, or logical invariant violated

diagnosis.description: Concrete technical explanation and suggested repair path for @Engineer

historical_attempts.description: Append-only ledger of prior repair attempts in this run to prevent oscillation
